name: Storming Grasp, Lesser
body:
School evocation [electricity]; Level bloodrager 2, magus 2, sorcerer/wizard 2

Targets one creature/level touched
Duration 1 min./level (D)

This spell functions as lesser shocking grasp except you can make one touch per caster level within the duration. Each touch is a separate standard action.

This touch attack can be delivered as part of spell combat and spellstrike without needing to cast the spell, so long as it is active.
